description: External benchmark corpus: real open-source repositories at pinned refs. Tasks reference the local clone under benchmarks/corpus/<name>.

repos.name: serde
repos.notes: Serde serialization framework; strong AST structure, trait-heavy.

repos.name: flask
repos.notes: Flask micro-framework; request routing and app lifecycle.

repos.name: express
repos.notes: Express web framework; middleware chain and router.

repos.name: django
repos.notes: Django web framework; large Python codebase for the L1 freshness benchmark (S1).

repos.name: tokio
repos.notes: Tokio async runtime workspace (tokio, tokio-util, tokio-stream, tokio-test, tokio-macros); about 112 k non-test lines of Rust, the second large repository for the agent pilots.

repos.name: scikit-learn
repos.notes: scikit-learn machine-learning library; about 186 k non-test lines of Python with heavy relative imports and re-exports; third large repository for the large-repository experiment.
